vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.0: Welcome to the dialogue demo! I'm the narrator: I get a whole parchment page in italics, without a portrait. Click or press space to see all the text at once, and again to go on.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.1: Hooray, a visitor! See how I hop up and down, with a little heart? That means happy. My name plate has the color of zone 1, and next to it is where I live.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.2: Oh dear, I sag a little and look down. That means sad. My plate is ice blue: the color of the Splinter Peaks.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.3: Oh! A little jump and an exclamation mark: surprised! Guhs from the Duskroot like me have a honey-yellow plate.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.4: Grr! I'm shaking with anger. Mikas get a gray plate and their own sly little voice.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.5: And this is me: my portrait is on the right and my plate is mint green.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.6: I belong to the Snuggle Order, that's why my plate is purple. Press L or the lines button to see the conversation log, and « Back or backspace to page back.
vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.7: This is a long page, to check that everything fits at GUI scale 2, 3 and 4. The text types itself, with a soft blip per word; how loud that blip is and how fast the text goes, you set under the little gear. Shift+space jumps straight to the choices. Below this text is the quest strip, and the choices each have a little icon: a book for a quest, an emerald for a shop, a map and a feather to travel, a door to leave. The number keys pick right away. And the "What should I do?" button tells you again who, what and where. Yippee!

vadsrijk.dialoog.demo.vol: A full screen: lots of text and nine choices. On a small window or GUI scale 4 the choices go in two columns side by side, and when the text no longer fits, you scroll it with the mouse wheel (or space). Nothing falls off the screen. This is some extra text so the balloon really fills up: guhs are always sweet, they love to cuddle, and their favorite cookies have pink icing and sprinkles, preferably three at once, and then a fourth one for later.

vadsrijk.huisdier.droomwalvisje.bron: Cheer up the Gray Dream in Mother Cloudwhale's dream.
vadsrijk.huisdier.droomwalvisje.tekst: A teeny-tiny pink cloudwhale that hums softly at night.
vadsrijk.huisdier.fennekje.bron: Rare: cheer up a Fennecguh in the Pink Dunes.
vadsrijk.huisdier.fennekje.tekst: A little fennecguh with ears bigger than its head. It hears everything.
vadsrijk.huisdier.galmpje.bron: Rare from the end chest of the Singing Salt Cave.
vadsrijk.huisdier.galmpje.tekst: A little salt lobster that softly sings along.
vadsrijk.huisdier.galmwolf.bron: Defeat the Echo Wolf on the Echo Slopes for the first time.
vadsrijk.huisdier.galmwolf.tekst: A crystal pup that wants to howl at the moon really loudly, but can only say 'squeak'. Glows a little in the dark.
vadsrijk.huisdier.glimhoedje.bron: Rare from the end chest of the Shroom Grotto.
vadsrijk.huisdier.glimhoedje.tekst: A teeny-tiny Mother Glowcap that softly gives off light.
vadsrijk.huisdier.klodderreus.bron: Defeat the Gray Blob Giant at the camp pond of Camp Snuggle for the first time.
vadsrijk.huisdier.klodderreus.tekst: Once fell into the camp pond with a huge SPLASH. Now he fits in your pocket. Still a little gray, but every cuddle helps.
vadsrijk.huisdier.knoestje.bron: Rare from the end chest of the Root Grotto.
vadsrijk.huisdier.knoestje.tekst: A mini Knotbelly. Loves a good nap.
vadsrijk.huisdier.koning_klodder.bron: Defeat King Blob for the first time.
vadsrijk.huisdier.koning_klodder.tekst: His little crown is three sizes too big. Every morning he demands a throne and gets a cushion. He's very happy with it.
vadsrijk.huisdier.kracht.drakenwarmte.do: %s breathes a little pink flame: you feel better!
%s breathes a big pink flame: healed and shielded!

vadsrijk.huisdier.kracht.galmlied.tekst: In a fight he sings you a bit of energy every 10 s.
vadsrijk.huisdier.kracht.klodderschild.d: %s gives you a little blob shield!
vadsrijk.huisdier.kracht.klodderschild.t: When your Chonk drops below half in a fight, he wraps a sticky little shield around you (every 30 s).
vadsrijk.huisdier.kracht.koninklijk_kuss: Outside of fights you get a bit of Chonk back every second.
vadsrijk.huisdier.kracht.kruimeltjes_rap: Picks up your loot lying around you, and sometimes finds a bonus coin after a victory.
vadsrijk.huisdier.kracht.scherp_oog.teks: Sniffs out secrets nearby (plushies, treasures, clues) and points them out with a golden trail. Sometimes finds a bonus coin.
vadsrijk.huisdier.kracht.snuffeltje.teks: Picks up your loot lying close by.
vadsrijk.huisdier.kruinroofvogel.bron: Defeat the Canopy Raptor on the Bald Crown
vadsrijk.huisdier.kruinroofvogel.tekst: A teeny-tiny raptor with ruffled little feathers. Loves pecking at your shoelaces.
vadsrijk.huisdier.level_op: %s is now level %s! Its power gets a little stronger.
vadsrijk.huisdier.lokpopje.tekst: One of Silvertail's decoys. It wants to belong to you now.

vadsrijk.huisdier.sterrenguhtje.tekst: A mini Star Guh. He always points toward the Mother Oasis.
vadsrijk.huisdier.sterrenpluisje.bron: Rare from the chest of The Star-Snuffing Tower.
vadsrijk.huisdier.sterrenpluisje.tekst: The Little Fluff, cheered up and teeny-tiny. Glows at night.
vadsrijk.huisdier.sterretje.bron: Rare: cheer up a Snuffed Starlet at The Mother Oasis.
vadsrijk.huisdier.sterretje.tekst: A cheered-up little star. It glows a little at night.
vadsrijk.huisdier.tinkeltje.bron: Rare from the end chest of the Crystal Grotto.

vadsrijk.huisdier.vahoegje.bron: Cheer up Wahoognir in the old nest
vadsrijk.huisdier.vahoegje.tekst: The baby dragon from the egg. Sneezes pink sparkles and thinks you're its mommy.
vadsrijk.huisdier.vliegertje.bron: Defeat Pinkie in the Wreck of the Kite Catcher
vadsrijk.huisdier.vliegertje.tekst: Pinkie's war kite, now pink and sweet. Flutters along behind you.
vadsrijk.huisdier.warmpje.bron: Defeat Overseer Gorgonzola in the Belly Tunnels.
vadsrijk.huisdier.warmpje.tekst: A little puff of warm air that escaped when you turned the valves open.
vadsrijk.huisdier.wormelientje.tekst: A teeny-tiny pink sand worm with eyelashes. Loves to nap in your pocket.
vadsrijk.huisdier.zeeslurfje.bron: Cheer up The Gray Sea Snoot in Coral Bay
vadsrijk.huisdier.zeeslurfje.tekst: A teeny-tiny pink sea cow with a little snoot. Snorts bubbles when he's happy.
vadsrijk.huisdier.zeurtje.bron: Rare from the end chest of the Coral Grotto.
vadsrijk.huisdier.zeurtje.tekst: A little snail that whines, but in a very cute way.

vadsrijk.huisdier.zoutklontje.tekst: A lump of star salt that was left behind when the Salt Colossus fell apart. It squeaks.

vadsrijk.huizen.poort.hallo: Hi! I'm the Quartermaster. Behind my little gate lies the Snuggle Quarter: a cozy neighborhood with little streets, a square, a little market and lots and lots of plots. You can buy a house of your very own there and decorate it all by yourself!

vadsrijk.huizen.rust.op: Your rested xp is all used up.
vadsrijk.huizen.uitleg.1: A district has 24 plots along four little streets. Walk around, pick a free plot and click its 'For sale!' sign. Is the district full? Then we simply build a new one.
vadsrijk.huizen.uitleg.2: You get one house per account: all your characters live together. There are three sizes (cottage, house, villa), each in three colors. Inside and in your garden you can decorate however you like; in the rest of the Chonkdom building stays off-limits.
vadsrijk.huizen.uitleg.3: At the mailbox you sort out everything: collect your mail, lock the door, add friends. Your mount waits in the little stable, your pets play in the garden, and if you log out at home you come back rested (double xp)!
vadsrijk.huizen.verkocht: Your house is sold. You get %s back; %s deco blocks are waiting for you at the mailbox of your next house.

vadsrijk.indeling.barriere.zijdewind: The warm Silk Wind gently blows you back. Without an airship you can't cross the strait.

vadsrijk.kern.tip.elementen: The little icon before a creature's name is its element:  Fire beats  Shroom, Shroom beats  Slime, Slime beats Fire (x1.5; the other way x0.7).  Pink is extra strong against dechonked creatures. No icon = no element.

vadsrijk.kern.tip.knuffelsprong: Press C for a big leap forward (about 20 blocks). Every class can do it, you always land softly, and after 5 seconds you can do it again.
vadsrijk.kern.tip.levelop: You have two levels. General (everything you do): more Chonk and Defense, new areas and quests. Class (the weapon you hit with): your main stat, skill points and better weapons.
vadsrijk.kern.tip.loot: The color of the lightbeam is the rarity. Only you can pick up your loot. Check the tooltip for the bonuses.
vadsrijk.kern.tip.skill: Skills cost Chonk Energy (blue bar) and have a cooldown. Z charges up by dealing damage.
vadsrijk.kern.tip.vast: Stuck somewhere? Press U (or /guhs vadsrijk vast) and stand still for 3 seconds: the snuggle wind sets you down on the nearest safe spot. Works once a minute, not during a boss fight.
vadsrijk.kern.tip.welkom: Here you get your own backpack: your normal stuff is safe at home. Left mouse = bonk, R V G = skills, Z = your ultimate smack.

vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.1.tekst: Long ago, at the edge of the world, there lived an ordinary little Mika. No stronger than the rest. No smarter. Just... hungrier.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.2.tekst: He stole his first cheese nibble from a guh. When he ate it, for one second he felt something warm in his tummy. Chonk! And then it was gone again.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.3.tekst: So he took another one. And another. What he didn't understand, and what every guh knows: chonk only grows when you share it. What you grab melts in your pawsies.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.4.tekst: He had to grab more and more and reach further and further. First his own land, then his neighbors', century after century. That's why Mikas say: 'The Emperor has long arms.'
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.5.tekst: He emptied his own land completely: gray, skinny and silent. Then he put on a stolen little crown. It was too small. He called himself Emperor anyway.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.6.tekst: He built a castle around one single thing: the Empty Bowl, a bowl as big as a lake. All the chonk in the world has to go into it. It has never been full.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.7.tekst: That's why his castle is called Neverenough. Gray Chonk Pipes run to it like rivers, from every land he already has in his grip.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.8.tekst: The second moon is no moon. It's a gray lantern the Emperor hung above the west, to see where there's still chonk. Mikas call it the Eye.
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.9.tekst: Mikas scare each other at night: 'If you share your nibble, the Emperor will come and get you.' But in the margin someone has written: 'Maybe he never got a cookie.'
vadsrijk.puzzels.bladzijde.uitleg: Right-click to read. There are nine.
vadsrijk.puzzels.duw.vast: The block can't go that way.
vadsrijk.puzzels.fout: Hmm, that's not right. Everything goes back to the start.
vadsrijk.puzzels.herstel: Everything is back in its place.
vadsrijk.puzzels.luister: The stone is listening... whisper your answer in chat.
vadsrijk.puzzels.nacht: The star stones are still asleep. Come back when it's dark!
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_koraalgrot.aanwi: In the Coral Grotto lie four colored shell plates.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_koraalgrot.hint1: The sea is blue, seaweed is green...
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_koraalgrot.hint2: The order is: blue, green, yellow, pink.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_koraalgrot.uitle: Step on the plates in the right order: first the sea, then the seaweed, then the sun, and last of all the coral.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_kristalgrot.aanw: In the Crystal Grotto, ice mirrors catch the light.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_kristalgrot.hint: The beam has to go up before it can go left. Not every mirror takes part.
Up at the first mirror, left at the mirror above it, up, and then all the way left.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_kristalgrot.uitl: Turn the ice mirrors until the light beam hits the target at the top left.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_wolkengrot.aanwi: Deep in the Cloud Caves there's a cloud with a lock.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_wolkengrot.hint1: A cloud that cries drops something. Sleeping is done at night.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_wolkengrot.uitle: Turn the symbol stones (click) and press the button. Written in the cloud: first a cloud cries, then it sleeps, then it dreams.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_wortelgrot.aanwi: In the Root Grotto, root knots are in the way.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_wortelgrot.hint1: First look where you have to STAND to push a knot the right way.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_wortelgrot.hint2: Start with the knot at the bottom left: down once.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_wortelgrot.uitle: Push the root knots (click them) onto the squares. Stuck? The reset button puts everything back.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_zwamgrot.aanwijz: Deep in the Shroom Grotto stand stones that know an echo.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_zwamgrot.hint1: The song has five notes and starts at the stone in the middle.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_zwamgrot.hint2: Middle, top left, bottom left, top right, bottom right.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.grot_zwamgrot.uitleg: The Shroom Grotto sings back! Click the Demo Stone, listen to the echo and play the song back on the singing stones.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_fluistersteen.aanw: At the back of the Blob Meadow, a stone whispers among the flowers.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_fluistersteen.hint: Every guh knows it: it only grows when you share it.
The word has five letters and it's a bar on your screen.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_fluistersteen.uitl: Click the stone and whisper the answer in chat.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_fluistersteen.vraa: I don't get less when you give me away, I get MORE. What am I?
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_gebarsten_muur.aan: By the lowest campfire of the Drip Caves stands a little wall with a crack.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_gebarsten_muur.uit: A little wall with a crack in it. There's something behind it...
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_kleurplaten.aanwij: By the first campfire of the Blob Meadow lie four colored plates.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_kleurplaten.hint1: Grass is green, a blushing cheek is pink...
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_kleurplaten.hint2: The order is: green, pink, blue, yellow.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_kleurplaten.uitleg: Step on the plates in the right order. First the grass, then a blushing cheek, then the sky, and last of all the sun.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_lichtstraal.aanwij: Among the light beams of the Sporewood, one has lost its way.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_lichtstraal.hint1: Follow the beam from the light stone. Where it hits a mirror, it bends.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_lichtstraal.hint2: The beam has to go down twice and right once. You don't need the bottom-left and top-right mirrors.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_lichtstraal.uitleg: Turn the mirrors (click them) until the light beam hits the light target.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_sterrenveld.aanwij: On Hat Hopper Meadow lie stones that only wake up at night.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_sterrenveld.hint1: The constellation is called The Snuggle Star: it's a little heart.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_sterrenveld.hint2: Click the star map again: each star on the map is one stone. Top row: the 2nd and 4th stone.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_sterrenveld.uitleg: Only at night! Read the star map and make the right star stones light up. Then press the button.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_symboolslot.aanwij: On the way to the Shroom Temple stand three turning stones.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_symboolslot.hint1: Feeling is done with your heart. Seeing is done in the night sky.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_symboolslot.uitleg: Turn the symbol stones (click) and press the button. The old temple wall said: what you feel, what you see and what you dream.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_vuurtorenschuur.aa: At Camp Snuggle, by the lighthouse, there's a little shed that never opens.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_vuurtorenschuur.hi: Take a look behind the shed, between the little bushes.
There's a little lever behind the shed.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_vuurtorenschuur.ui: A little shed without a door handle...
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_zwammenlied.aanwij: In the Sporewood the stones sing a little song, right by the campfire.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_zwammenlied.hint1: Watch closely which stone lights up. The song has five notes, and one stone sings twice.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_zwammenlied.hint2: Left, right, middle, right, and then the stone at the front.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z1_zwammenlied.uitleg: Click the Demo Stone and listen. Then play the song back on the singing shroom stones.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_ijsgrot.aanwijzing: Right by the western campfire of the Splinter Gorge there's a crack in the ice.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_ijsgrot.uitleg: A little ice wall with a crack...
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_ijsschuif.aanwijzi: By Snuggle Lake lie ice blocks that want to go home.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_ijsschuif.hint1: A block moves away from the side you push it from. You can't pull!
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_ijsschuif.hint2: The left block goes down twice, the right block goes up twice.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_ijsschuif.uitleg: Push the ice blocks (click them) onto the pink squares. Stuck? Press the reset button.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_kristallied.aanwij: On the Echo Slopes stand stones that know a song.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_kristallied.hint1: The song has six notes. It starts and ends at the stone in the middle.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_kristallied.hint2: Middle, bottom left, top left, bottom right, top right, middle.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_kristallied.uitleg: The Echo Slopes sing back. Listen to the Demo Stone and play the song back.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_kristalspiegels.aa: In the Splinter Gorge, light breaks in crystals.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_kristalspiegels.hi: The beam has to go up before it can go right. Not every mirror takes part.
Up at the first mirror, right at the mirror above it, up, and then all the way right.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_kristalspiegels.ui: Turn the crystal mirrors until the light beam hits the target at the top right.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_lantaarnsprint.aan: On the Echo Slopes stands a lantern with a stopwatch.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_lantaarnsprint.hin: You don't need to run: jumping from pillar to pillar is fastest.
Straight ahead, then up at the corner, and at the top back to the left.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_lantaarnsprint.uit: Click the lantern and jump across the crystal pillars to the finish plate. You have 25 seconds!
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_poollicht.aanwijzi: By Snuggle Lake lie star stones that only wake up at night.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_poollicht.hint1: The constellation is called The Crystal: a diamond with a dot in the middle.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_poollicht.hint2: Middle row: the 1st, 3rd and 5th stone. The corners stay dark.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_poollicht.uitleg: Only at night! Copy the constellation from the star map with the star stones and press the button.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_raadselsteen.aanwi: By the Lakeside Camp, a stone is shivering with cold.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_raadselsteen.hint1: In winter, Snuggle Lake is made of it all over.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_raadselsteen.hint2: Three letters. You can skate on it.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_raadselsteen.uitle: Click the stone and whisper the answer in chat.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z2_raadselsteen.vraag: I'm a lake that wants to stand still. I'm slippery and cold, and in the sun I melt away. What am I?
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_bijenlied.aanwijzi: Below the Honeybough, along the Root Road, singing stones are buzzing.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_bijenlied.hint1: The song has six notes and no stone sings twice.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_bijenlied.hint2: Back row the first two, then front row right and left, then back row the last two.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_bijenlied.uitleg: The bees of the Honeybough always hummed a little song. Listen to the Demo Stone and hum along.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_honingfluister.aan: By the Mossfoot, a stone is buzzing.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_honingfluister.hin: Take a look at the hives on the Honeybough.
Three letters, and it rhymes with 'tree'.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_honingfluister.uit: Click the stone and whisper the answer in chat.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_honingfluister.vra: I buzz and I dance, I make something sweet, and I live with a thousand sisters on the Honeybough. What am I?
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_lantaarnloop.aanwi: Along the Root Road in the southwest, a lantern stands among honey pillars.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_lantaarnloop.hint1: Start at the bottom and go counterclockwise. Some pillars are a dead end.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_lantaarnloop.hint2: Bottom row to the right, right side up, top row to the left.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_lantaarnloop.uitle: Click the lantern and run across the honey pillars to the finish plate. You have 30 seconds!
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_mossymbolen.aanwij: By the Root Vault stand four mossy turning stones.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_mossymbolen.hint1: What's green on a tree? What's wet? What's warm?
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_mossymbolen.uitleg: Turn the symbol stones and press the button. The old moss rhyme goes like this: first green, then wet, then warm, and green again.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_schorsdeur.aanwijz: Along the Root Road in the southeast stands a little house without a door handle.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_schorsdeur.hint1: Take a look behind the little house, between the little bushes.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_schorsdeur.hint2: There's a little lever behind the house.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_schorsdeur.uitleg: A little bark house without a door handle...
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_wortelplaten.aanwi: Along the Root Road, in the east, lie four colored plates.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_wortelplaten.hint1: The sun is yellow, the blossom is pink.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_wortelplaten.uitle: Step on the plates in the right order. The sun wakes up, the sky turns blue, the blossom blushes and the moss grows too.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_wortelschuif.aanwi: On the west side of the Root Road, knots lie all crooked.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_wortelschuif.hint1: First look where you have to STAND to push a knot the right way.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_wortelschuif.hint2: Start with the knot at the bottom right: down once.
vadsrijk.puzzels.p.z3_wortelschuif.uitle: Push the root knots (click them) onto the squares. Stuck? The reset button puts everything back.

vadsrijk.ruiters.trap: Stairs are the very best: hup, hup, hup!
vadsrijk.ruiters.verzorger: Just brushing the feathers a bit... there, all shiny!
vadsrijk.ruiters.wacht: Just waiting for Plumey to finish eating.
vadsrijk.ruiters.z1.1: This is a Plumeguh! They come from The Duskroot, the giant tree far away.
vadsrijk.ruiters.z1.2: Mail for Shroomsbury! Make way, make way, the courier's coming!
vadsrijk.ruiters.z3.1: Do you have your own Plumeguh yet? Ask at the Plume Stable!
vadsrijk.ruiters.z3.4: My Plumeguh knows every branch of this tree.
vadsrijk.ruiters.z3.5: Wahoog! Just popping out for some honey.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.kar.ijs.2: Ding-a-ling, the ice cream cart is here!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.kar.soep.1: A little bowl of soup to chase off the cold?
vadsrijk.stadsleven.kar.soep.2: Ding-a-ling, the soup cart is here!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.kat.0: Meow! (The cat gives you a happy look.)
vadsrijk.stadsleven.kat.1: Prrrr... (The cat blinks slowly at you.)
vadsrijk.stadsleven.kat.2: (The cat stretches and settles down all cozy.)
vadsrijk.stadsleven.kind.3: I'm the fastest guh in the whole town!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.kind.4: Hee hee, you can't catch me!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.kind.7: When I grow up, I'll be a knight too!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.klets.1: Have you tried that new cuddle bakery yet?
vadsrijk.stadsleven.klets.10: Soft day, soft guh, just the way it should be.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.klets.11: Can you hear the kids at the playground? So much fun!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.klets.12: I think it's going to rain pink later.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.klets.13: Everyone is welcome at our little table!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.klets.2: My granny says: a cuddle a day keeps the grayness away.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.klets.4: Last night I dreamed I was a little cloud.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.klets.5: Shall we go for a little walk later?
vadsrijk.stadsleven.klets.6: My mousie squeaked three times today. A record!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.klets.7: Those knights of the Snuggle Order are just so brave.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.klets.8: Careful, you've got whipped cream on your little ear!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.klets.9: I'm just here to sit. And to nibble.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.muziek.2: ♪ Nyeg nyeg, what a lovely day ♪
vadsrijk.stadsleven.muziek.3: I wrote this song for the dragon.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.picknick.1: Watch out, an ant is crawling toward the cake!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z1.0: Have you heard? A big dragon lives behind the mountains.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z1.1: That dragon isn't angry, says Grandmaster Chonkfoot. He's sad.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z1.2: King Blob made the whole Blob Meadow sticky again.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z1.3: The other day I saw a Mika sneaking through Shroomsbury. With a fake mustache!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z1.4: At night you can hear the Overshroom snoring in the Shroom Temple.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z1.5: There's a dragon fossil in the mountains. Could it be family of the dragon?
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z1.6: My little nephew wants to be a knight of the Snuggle Order when he grows up too.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z1.7: They say the Emperor has long arms. Luckily mine are short.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z1.8: The airship to the Splinter Peaks is all full again.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z1.9: If you don't share your nibble, the Emperor will come and get you. That's what my granny says.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z2.0: Brrr! But with warm soup, the cold is actually pretty snug.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z2.1: Order Master Crystalline says the crystals are softly singing again.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z2.2: Lady Mirrorsigh looks at herself all day long in the Mirror Keep.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z2.3: In the mines, a Mika is drilling holes in our lovely crystals!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z2.4: That gray splinter in the crystal is no ordinary splinter, you know.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z2.5: The Echo Wolf howls so loudly the snow falls off the roofs.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z2.6: Did you know the dragon used to fly over the peaks?
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z2.7: In the pink geode, it's always a little bit of a party.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z2.8: My scarf was knitted by my grandpa. He's a hundred and two!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z2.9: They say the Emperor has sent his Mikas around even here.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z3.0: Count Squeakula keeps mousies in little cages. That's not nice, is it?
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z3.1: I heard the Canopy Raptor screeching up by the treetop again.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z3.2: Order Master Waxie says the dragon once lived in the old nest.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z3.3: Shall we take a Plumeguh and race up the spiral staircase?
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z3.4: The little bees are making extra sweet honey this year.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z3.5: Baron Bleu smells like old cheese. Really!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z3.6: If you listen closely, you can hear the tree creak. It's still growing!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z3.7: There's a Mika down in the roots called Roquefort. Brrr.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z3.8: They say the dragon turns pink again if someone cheers him up.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z3.9: From here you can see a floating city in the distance. Highchonk!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z4.0: Another lantern stolen! That Kite Catcher really needs to stop.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z4.1: The sweetest little shells wash up at the Snuggletide.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z4.2: Highchonk floats up there. On the back of a whale, imagine that!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z4.3: Yesterday more skinny guhs arrived by boat. From the east.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z4.4: Those refugees tell of gray roads and Mika caravans. Scary stuff.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z4.5: My kite went so high it almost touched Highchonk!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z4.6: Tonight all the lanterns light up again. Pretty, huh?
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z4.7: Old Bobber has been bobbing around Turtle Island for a hundred years, they say.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z4.8: At low tide you can hunt for little treasure chests at the Snuggletide.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z4.9: The lighthouse winks at the airships. How polite.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z5.0: Mother Cloudwhale is swimming awfully calmly today, don't you think?
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z5.1: They say Mother Cloudwhale has gray dreams. Poor whale.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z5.2: In the Council Hall there's a book with a torn page. What did it say?
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z5.3: The High Council talks about the Emperor, but only when nobody's listening.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z5.4: At the university they learn how to measure chonk. Complicated stuff.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z5.5: The Unchonked get a little rounder and happier every day. Lovely!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z5.6: The Cloudwatch cadets are drilling on the square again. Hup, hup!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z5.7: When Mother Cloudwhale sings, all the cups on the terrace rattle.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z5.8: Up here above the clouds, at least you never get wet feet.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z5.9: Rumor has it Mother Cloudwhale will swim to the mainland one day.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z6.0: The caravan only leaves when the stars are right.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z6.1: More Star Beacons have gone out. Who would do something so mean?
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z6.2: Duchess Ringaling wears rings on all ten of her toes. Ten!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z6.3: At the bazaar I saw a flying carpet that just wouldn't land.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z6.4: My humpguh is stubborn, but he can walk for days without water.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z6.5: Somewhere beyond the dunes lies the hidden Mother Oasis.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z6.6: In the palace's hall of mirrors you see yourself a hundred times over.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z6.7: That gray tower by the oasis... I'm really not going there.
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z6.8: In Rose Gorge everything is pink. Even the grains of sand!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.roddel.z6.9: Without stars, the caravan loses its way. Good thing you're here!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.speel.2: Up and down, up and down!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.speel.4: I'm building a sandcastle for the dragon!
vadsrijk.stadsleven.wandel.4: Want to pet him? He thinks you're sweet!

vadsrijk.uritme.krant.gisteren.rustig.2: Quiet day yesterday. Even the blobs took a nap.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.gisteren.rustig.3: Yesterday: two little clouds, one little rainbow, zero problems.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.gisteren.rustig.4: The editors had the day off yesterday. So this bit is from the day before.

vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.1: %1$s found %2$s under a cushion. The cushion denies everything.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.10: %1$s is giving out free hugs. %3$s left.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.11: Fact of the day: a blob can bounce %3$s times before it giggles.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.12: %1$s has a new haircut. Nobody sees the difference, everybody says 'lovely!'.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.13: Lost and found: %2$s. Pick it up at %1$s's, after a hug.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.14: %1$s practices the trumpet at night. Neighbors: 'It's getting better.'
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.15: Urgent: %1$s needs someone to hold %2$s while %1$s sneezes.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.16: Letter to the editor: 'Could it be a bit less pink? Regards, nobody.'
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.2: Survey: %3$s out of 10 guhs find hugging 'pretty nice'. The rest were busy hugging.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.3: %1$s organizes a 'longest yawn' contest. Winner: %1$s (fell asleep).
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.4: Wanted: %2$s. Last seen on a blob's lap.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.6: Science: a guh that gets waved at waves back %3$s percent happier.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.7: %1$s trades %2$s for a song. Everybody thinks it's a good deal.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.8: Mystery: who leaves a little flower at %1$s's door every morning?
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.alg.9: Squeaksqueak mouse seen with %2$s. The mouse clearly had plans for it.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.haven.1: Seagull steals a fry, then hands it back, ashamed.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.haven.2: Airship lands so softly the passengers didn't notice and stayed on for another lap.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.haven.3: Harbormaster counts the little waves: 'Today 4,812, yesterday there were more.'
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.haven.4: Little fish jumps out of the water, waves, and jumps back in. Witnesses are moved.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.haven.5: New on the quay: a bench that hugs back. The line reaches the water.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.haven.6: Rope in a knot. Rope doesn't want to talk about it.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.honingtak.1: Bee lands on the mayor's nose and stays for an hour. 'It felt like an honor.'
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.honingtak.2: Honey tea so sweet the spoon stood up by itself.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.honingtak.3: Branch creaks a little. Branch says it's nothing.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.honingtak.4: Combsy counts 1,000,001 bees. 'I don't know that one extra.'
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.honingtak.5: Blossom petal falls into someone's tea. The tea is now 'posh'.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.honingtak.6: Hanging nest sways so sweetly that three adventurers fell asleep mid-conversation.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.hoogvads.1: Little cloud gets stuck in the cathedral and listens to the whole sermon.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.hoogvads.2: University discovers: guhs get 12%% fluffier above the clouds.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.hoogvads.3: Palace guard forgets his password. The password was 'fluff'.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.hoogvads.4: Market Lane: baker sells buns that gently float. 'Eat quickly.'
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.hoogvads.5: Academy teaches 'posh waving'. Everybody gets an A+.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.hoogvads.6: Tail Park: cloudwhale waves its tail. Half the city gets a breeze.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.kandijkom.1: Snow guh built that sings better than the choir. Choir considers becoming snow.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.kandijkom.2: Hot cocoa now with extra foam. 'The foam is extra warm too', the innkeeper confirms.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.kandijkom.3: Icicle falls off a roof and lands right in a mug. Applause.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.kandijkom.4: Mitten epidemic: single mittens found everywhere. Nobody is missing one.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.kandijkom.5: Gondola does an extra lap 'because the view was so pretty'.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.kandijkom.6: Crystal spire in the mountains hums softly at night. Scientists hum along.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.knuffelkamp: Training dummy says 'ouch' but means 'thank you'.
Campfire crackles a song. Cook sings along.
New adventurer arrived. Everybody waves. Adventurer waves back. Everybody waves even harder.
Fisher Bobber catches a boot. The boot caught a little fish. Everybody happy.
Tent blows over, gets put back up, blows over again. Tent is having a great time.
Camp guard sees a blob. Blob sees the camp guard. They nod at each other.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.lampionhave: Paper lantern floats away and comes back an hour later with a friend.
Soup of the day: fish soup. Soup of yesterday: also fish soup. Tomorrow: surprise (fish soup).
Little crab walks straight for the first time. The whole beach cheers.
Little sailboat sails a lap around the fountain. Nobody knows how it got there.
Lemonade stand sells lemonade that tastes like sunset.
Lighthouse winks at the harbor. Harbor blushes.
Rose in the gorge blooms so hard it has to sneeze.
Little wall found that nobody has ever climbed. Little wall is relieved.
Rose water now also in the flavor 'extra pink'.
The echo in the gorge says 'good morning' back every morning. Even when nobody said anything.
Camel refuses to take the stairs. Stairs understand.
Square gets new heart-shaped tiles. Old tiles may stay for a sleepover.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.saffraanpoo: Bazaar sells a carpet that flies back to the stall by itself. No return policy needed.
Spice stall sneezes. Half the market sneezes along.
Palace seeks a new cushion fluffer. Experience with fluff a plus.
Grain of sand found in someone's shoe. Not news, but still.
Potter makes a pot so round it rolled away to the gate.
Caravan arrives with 300 crates of dates and one lost guh. The guh may stay.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.zwamzoet.1: Mushroom on the square grew one centimeter. Mayor: 'We are proud.'
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.zwamzoet.2: Baker Ben accidentally bakes a loaf as big as a guh. The loaf refuses to leave.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.zwamzoet.3: Order Temple reports: the big bell now sounds 3%% happier.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.zwamzoet.4: Blob spotted politely waiting its turn at the smith. Nobody knows what it wanted.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.zwamzoet.5: Granny Trudy wins the 'Softest Scarf' contest for the eleventh time. The jury needed a little cry.
vadsrijk.uritme.krant.nieuws.zwamzoet.6: Lamplighter asks the lanterns to switch themselves on from now on. Lanterns: no comment.

vadsrijk.uritme.markt.koek.hallo: A star cookie, kiddo? With a fortune inside. They always come true. Almost always. %s bronze.
vadsrijk.uritme.markt.koek.op: Nibble... the fortune says: "%s" You feel a bit better too.
vadsrijk.uritme.markt.koek.spreuk.1: Today someone hugs you back. Maybe a bench.
vadsrijk.uritme.markt.koek.spreuk.2: Your next loot will be pink. Or not. But it'll be sweet.
vadsrijk.uritme.markt.koek.spreuk.3: A blob is thinking of you. It just can't remember why.
vadsrijk.uritme.markt.koek.spreuk.4: Wave at three guhs and your day gets 3x softer.
vadsrijk.uritme.markt.koek.spreuk.5: You will lose something. It's a crumb. Of this cookie.
vadsrijk.uritme.markt.koek.spreuk.6: Maybe it'll rain tomorrow. Bring a rainbow.
vadsrijk.uritme.markt.koek.spreuk.7: You are a hero. Especially to this cookie, which you just ate.
vadsrijk.uritme.markt.koek.spreuk.8: Look up tonight. The stars are waving.
vadsrijk.uritme.markt.snoep.hallo: Lantern candies! They glow in your tummy and make your paws go faster! Only %s bronze.
vadsrijk.uritme.markt.snoep.op: Mmm! Your paws tingle: one minute of Quickpaws!
vadsrijk.uritme.markt.te_weinig: Oopsie, you don't quite have enough coins for that.
vadsrijk.uritme.slaper.klik.2: The guh mumbles something about cheese nibbles and sleeps on.
vadsrijk.uritme.slaper.klik.3: Shh! It's dreaming that it's a little cloud.
vadsrijk.vfx.cast.onderbreek: Interrupt! Hit it hard or stun it
vadsrijk.vfx.onderbroken: %s interrupted! The boss is dazed for a moment.
vadsrijk.vfx.woede: %s is enraged: its attacks come more often!
vadsrijk.vint.bond.uitleg.1: A Snuggle Squad is a club of players. Together you earn squad xp with everything you already do: monsters, quests, levels and professions.
vadsrijk.vint.bond.uitleg.2: You can join from zone 1: check a Squad Board in any town. Founding your own squad is only possible in Highchonk, at Squad Clerk Stampy.
vadsrijk.vint.bond.uitleg.3: Every squad gets a castle in Squad Valley that you build up together (level 1 to 5), with a vault, trophy hall and workshops.
vadsrijk.vint.bond.voet: Buttons open the squad panel in the chat (also: /bond, /bc to chat)
vadsrijk.vint.buit.mis: No %s this time (10%%). In %s more tries at most, it's guaranteed yours.
vadsrijk.vint.huis.intro: The Snuggle Quarter is a neighborhood of its own with little streets, neighbors, a square and a market. You buy a plot with a little house you furnish yourself.
vadsrijk.vint.huis.titel: My house in the Snuggle Quarter
vadsrijk.vint.huis.waar: Getting there: talk to the Quartermaster on the square of any capital (Shroomsbury, Sugarbowl, Honeybough, Lanternhaven, Highchonk).
vadsrijk.vint.z6raid.halster.al: You already have the Starnight Humpguh.
vadsrijk.vint.z6raid.halster.ok: The Humpguh in Starnight coat is yours! (N = mounts)
vadsrijk.vint.z6raid.halster.uitleg: Right-click: the Humpguh in Starnight coat (mount + coat).
vadsrijk.voltooiing.beloning.chat: You've done everything in %s! You get the title %s and %s.
vadsrijk.voltooiing.hint.rijdier.guhwolf: Got a mount yet? Something howls in Sugarbowl...
vadsrijk.voltooiing.hint.rijdier.knuffel: Got a mount yet? Ranger Moss knows something about the Sporewood.
vadsrijk.voltooiing.hint.rijdier.pluimgu: With Stable Master Feathers in the Plume Stable, on the ground at the north side of the tree.
vadsrijk.voltooiing.hint.rijdier.wolkens: Got a mount yet? Stable Master Hoofy has a little chore for you.
vadsrijk.voltooiing.hint.uitkijk: A tall spire in %s. Climb to the top!
vadsrijk.voltooiing.later.tip: You only get mounts further on in the Chonkdom. They don't count toward your percentage.
vadsrijk.vriendjes.aai.0: Wahoognir purrs like a really big kitty.
vadsrijk.vriendjes.aai.1: Wahoognir rests his soft head against you for a moment.
vadsrijk.vriendjes.aai.2: A little finch on his back chirps along. Wahoognir giggles.
vadsrijk.vriendjes.aai.3: Wahoognir blinks slowly at you. That means: I think you're sweet.
vadsrijk.vriendjes.aai.4: His ears turn a tiny bit pinker.
vadsrijk.vriendjes.aai.5: Wahoognir rumbles so happily that the ground tickles a little.
vadsrijk.vriendjes.bezoek: A happy rumble sounds in the distance... Wahoognir is stopping by to say hi!
vadsrijk.web.kaart.getoond: You're on the live map of guhs.nl again (never in dungeons, houses or Squad Valley). Hide? /guhs vadsrijk kaart verberg
vadsrijk.web.kaart.verborgen: You're no longer on the live map of guhs.nl. Back on it? /guhs vadsrijk kaart toon
vadsrijk.wereld.deur.dicht.ordetempel: The Snuggle Door stays shut. Use the side door, nyeg!
vadsrijk.wereld.deur.dicht.spiegelburcht: The mirror door only reflects your own face. There must be a key...
vadsrijk.wereld.deur.dicht.zwamtempel: The temple door is shut tight. Maybe someone in Shroomsbury knows how to open it.
vadsrijk.wereld.deur.dicht.zwamtempel_bi: The inner door won't listen. Solve the puzzles first!
vadsrijk.wereld.deur.onder.zwamtempel_bi: Whoever brings the light may enter
vadsrijk.wereld.deur.vast: This door is stuck while there's fighting here.
vadsrijk.wereld.luchtschip.nog_niet: The captain is taking a nap. Come back in a bit, nyeg.
vadsrijk.wereld.portaal.aan: The portal awakens! Wahoog, off to the Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.wereld.portaal.eerst_zelf: Nyeg! The portal doesn't recognize you yet. First find the old order temple in the Guhmension yourself.
vadsrijk.wereld.portaal.geen_raam: That's not a closed frame of Chonkdom Portal Stone. Build a rectangle (inside max 21 by 21).
vadsrijk.wereld.uitkijk.gevonden: Lookout found: %s. What a chonky view!
vadsrijk.wereld.z2.gondel.dicht: The gondola isn't moving yet. The gondolaguh is finishing his hot cocoa first.
vadsrijk.wereld.z2.luchtschip.nog_niet: The captain shakes his head: first this part of the Chonkdom needs your help. Nyeg.
vadsrijk.wereld.z2.luchtschip.onder_have: Back by guh-balloon line. Nice and warm!
vadsrijk.wereld.z2.luchtschip.te_laag: The captain looks worried: up there it's freezing and dangerous. Come back at level %s.
vadsrijk.wereld.z2.luchtschip.tip: Sneak and click the bell for the line to Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.wereld.z2.opening.chocomelk: Phew, that was a close call! Welcome to Sugarbowl. First, a mug of hot cocoa.
vadsrijk.wereld.z2.opening.onder: Where chonk turns to gray crystal
vadsrijk.wereld.z3.honinglift.dicht: The Great Honey Lift isn't moving yet. Once you know the way through the trunk, it opens.
vadsrijk.wereld.z3.luchtschip.nog_niet: The captain peers east: I won't fly that far until the Splinter Peaks are safe again.
vadsrijk.wereld.z3.luchtschip.te_laag: The captain frowns: real monsters live in that tree. Come back at level %s.
vadsrijk.wereld.z3.opening.onder: A Tree as Big as a Mountain
vadsrijk.wereld.z3.opening.stem: He's still alive... but not for much longer.
vadsrijk.wereld.z3.opening.welkom: Welcome to Honeybough! Mmm, it smells of honey and blossom here. Beemother Combsy is waiting on Blossom Square.
vadsrijk.wezens.cmd.draak: Wahoognir is flying over! Look up.
vadsrijk.wezens.kampklodder.aai: The Camp Blob wiggles with joy. Blub!
vadsrijk.wezens.kampklodder.aai2: Blub blub! The Camp Blob gives you a blobby-wet hug.
vadsrijk.wezens.kampklodder.aai3: The Camp Blob makes a happy little bubble.
vadsrijk.wezens.set.klodder.2: (2) Slippery: 15%% chance that a hit just slides right off you
vadsrijk.wezens.set.klodder.4: (4) Bounce Power: +12%% damage and your hits sometimes cause Sticky
vadsrijk.wezens.set.zwam.4: (4) Spore Rain: +12%% spell damage and your spells apply Spored
vadsrijk.wezens.tip.elite: Golden glow = elite. Stronger, bigger and with a trait (Glowing, Fast, Splitting or Shielding), but better loot too!
vadsrijk.wezens.tip.glimzwam: The Glowshroom heals the creatures around it. Cheer it up first!
vadsrijk.wezens.tip.kristalklodder: Its crystals sometimes reflect spells. Normal hits always work.
vadsrijk.wezens.tip.mosgeest: A Moss Spirit sometimes swooshes aside. Stick with it, it can't dodge every time.
vadsrijk.wezens.tip.sporenpuffer: Stay out of the green cloud: it applies Spored (damage and less healing).
vadsrijk.wezens.tip.tempelridder: See the red strip? That's its swing. Step aside!
vadsrijk.wezens.tip.zwamwachter: From the front it blocks with its cap shield. Walk around it or hit it right after it has swung!

Her tail waves softly: all of Highchonk swims along with her.
